description: Structured output schema for blind-ensemble decision recommendations. Used with codex exec --output-schema.

status.description: COMPLETE: a recommendation is made. BLOCKED: the brief is insufficient to decide; say why in rationale.

recommendation.description: The recommended option, stated plainly and unambiguously. Empty string only when BLOCKED.

rationale.description: Why this option wins against the brief's evaluation criteria, grounded in the constraints and (where relevant) the codebase.

risks.description: What could make this recommendation wrong, and what would signal that early.

rejected_alternatives.description: One entry per option from the brief that was not chosen.

confidence.description: How strongly the evidence supports the recommendation.
